summary: Shopping Lists feature end-to-end regression PASS. Backend: 31/31 pytest cases green (14 despensa_api + 2 purchase_total + 15 new shopping_lists). Verified: (a) currencies (5, regression), auth/me, markets, purchases CRUD + total recalc, monthly report, receipt/scan, (b) POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /api/shopping-lists, item add/update/delete, status=bought auto-stamps paid_market_name + paid_at from the market record, status=pending resets paid_price/paid_market_id/paid_market_name/paid_at to null, status=unavailable works, (c) GET /api/products/history aggregates purchases by name, sorts prices cheapest-first per market, exposes cheapest_market_name/cheapest_price, supports ?q= search filter. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x900, seeded Bearer test-token-abc123): Listas tab present in bottom nav (Inicio/Mercados/Listas/Reportes/Ajustes). Confirmed testIDs: lists-screen, add-list-btn, new-list-name-input, create-list-btn, navigates to /shopping-list/{id}, shopping-list-detail visible with Pendientes/Comprados/No había summary, add-item-fab opens AddItemSheet with tab-manual + tab-history, manual-name-input, manual-qty-input, manual-unit-un/kg, manual-cat-otros, save-manual-item-btn; history tab returns 2 historical products (Leche, Manzana) each with testID history-item-<name>, history-search-input works; item-row-<id>, toggle-bought-<id>, toggle-unavailable-<id>, delete-item-<id> all present; MarkBoughtSheet shows buy-qty-input, buy-price-input, save-bought-btn, 5 buy-market-<id> chips, and buy-total-preview correctly renders 'Total: ₲ 10.000' for price 5000 × qty 2. No red-screen errors, no red-500 API failures during flow. Deprecated packages detected: none. React Native Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents) persist from prior iterations — non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web still logs 'shadow* style props are deprecated (use boxShadow)' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents)'. Non-blocking, carried over from iteration_1/2/3.

action_items: OPTIONAL (still open): migrate remaining RN Web deprecated props (shadow* -> boxShadow, pointerEvents prop -> style.pointerEvents).

OPTIONAL polish (server.py:531-547): PUT /shopping-lists/{id}/items/{item_id} — the pending-reset branch uses setdefault() for paid_price/paid_market_id/paid_market_name, so a client that sets status=pending but ALSO passes paid_price would keep the stale value. Current tests + UI never do that (status changes always come alone or with bought+market+price), so behavior is correct for the shipped flows, but consider forcing these to None unconditionally when status!=bought.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:508-568 shopping-list item routes correctly re-fetch the full doc after $push/$pull/$set — clients always receive the up-to-date items array. Good.

server.py:571-629 /products/history keeps last price per market and returns prices sorted cheapest-first with cheapest_market_name — matches the UI's price-comparison pill; date comparison guards against None so no crash on old rows.
shopping-list/[id].tsx MarkBoughtSheet uses parseFloat(price)*parseFloat(qty) for buy-total-preview which matches backend total accounting (paid_price is unit price × quantity). Good.
lists.tsx and shopping-list/[id].tsx: create-list sheet + AddItemSheet + MarkBoughtSheet all use RN Modal with KeyboardAvoidingView + Pressable-outside-close — safe.

conftest.py deletes markets/purchases for the test user at session start, so /products/history for TEST user relies on the two purchases we seed inside test_shopping_lists.py. Real-user data in other DBs untouched.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for all testIDs in acceptance criteria

Auth bypass for UI: localStorage.setItem('despensa_token','test-token-abc123') then reload.
